lines: One consisting-of-manifestation seed, whose vigor pervading all mantras; one mudrā Khecarī and, multitude of mudrās animated by whom.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ekaṃ sṛṣṭimayaṃ bījaṃ yadvīryaṃ sarvamantragam ekā mudrā khecarī ca mudraughaḥ prāṇito yayā
